newsitem.title: USA: Sun to build Inland coke ovens.
newsitem.headline: Sun to build Inland coke ovens.

text.p: Inland Steel Co said Thursday it Sun Coal and Coke Co will build and operate new coke ovens that will dramatically reduce Inland's cost for coke, a key raw material used in steel production.
Separately, Sun Co Inc said Sun Coal will invest $185 million in the ovens at Inland's Indiana Harbor Works in East Chicago, which will use Sun's coke technology.

In addition, Inland said, NIPSCO Industries Inc's Primary Energy unit will build and operate the portion of the project that will remove sulfur from the coke plant's flue gas and use the heat from the plant to produce steam and energy.
